from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InstitutionApplication(BaseModel):
    """Application count for first-time, first-year students at one institution."""
    institution_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the institution")
    total_applicants_first_year: int | None = Field(description="Total number of degree-seeking first-time, first-year students who applied")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period in YYYY-MM format, e.g., 2021-09 for Fall 2021")
    men_applicants: int | None = Field(description="Number of male applicants who are first-time, first-year")
    women_applicants: int | None = Field(description="Number of female applicants who are first-time, first-year")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    institution_applications: list[InstitutionApplication]
